name: i2c-rtc-68
description: DS1307-compatible I2C real-time clock at I2C 0x68 on BSC1 — driver written and verified by claude-sonnet-5 during AI incubation
evidence: Registers 0x00-0x06 decoded as valid BCD time/calendar: sec=0x29(29), min=0x59(59), hour=0x14(14, 24h mode), day-of-week=2, date=0x05(5), month=0x10(10), year=0x26(26) -> 14:59:29 on 2026-10-05. Register 0x07 (control) = 0x00 (square-wave/out disabled). Registers 0x0E-0x12 (which on a DS3231 would be alarm/control/aging/temperature) all read 0x00, matching DS1307's plain battery-backed RAM (unused/zeroed) rather than DS3231's active temperature/alarm registers which would show non-zero, actively-updated values. WHO_AM_I-style probe at 0x75 (MPU6050 address) returned 0x00, ruling out MPU6050 at this address.
